title: Check what each role sees
caption: Mirrors tools/e2e/specs/ota-admin/roles.e2e.ts (OF-09 AC2). Invite the members on the portal's Team page; each opens the console from the portal.

steps.title: Viewer
steps.body: Open console; open a booking in manual review.
steps.expect: TEST badge, no switch; no "Booking actions", no Issue, no Cancel; no Queues, Shopping or Supplier log in the navigation.

steps.title: Agent
steps.body: Open console on a live OTA; open the same booking.
steps.expect: TEST / LIVE switch; Issue and Cancel offered; Capture but no Refund on payments.

steps.title: Settings read only
steps.body: Open markups, fees, storefront, assets, pages, templates.
steps.expect: "New markup rule" and "New fee rule" disabled with "Needs the permission settings:write"; rules without a form; storefront fields disabled, no Save; "Upload an image" disabled; "New page" disabled; templates with Preview only.

steps.title: Forbidden pages
steps.expect: A state naming `settings:write`, no form; no settings row in `tenant_<key>.staff_actions`.

steps.title: Finance
steps.expect: Refund offered; no booking actions; supplier log readable.
